Rime Shackle.name: Rime Shackle
Rime Shackle.description: The user grips a target or sends frost along the ground to them and locks whichever limbs the user chooses in thick ice. The target cannot move those limbs until they break free with a hard effort, the ice is melted or the user lets it go, and the skin under the ice takes no harm. Strain: moderate.
